sources.title: 中卫数据中心集群宣和片区详细规划（公布稿）— Zhongwei Data Center Cluster Xuanhe Area Detailed Plan (published version)
sources.attribution: Zhongwei Data Bureau (中卫市数据局)
sources.summary: Published detailed plan of the Xuanhe area of the Zhongwei data-centre cluster (Wangyuan Village, Xuanhe Town; 824.82 ha planning area, 577.11 ha construction land), attached to the Zhongwei Data Bureau notice of 20 August 2026. Text names the road network (Sandang Highway county road, 26 m red line; trunk roads including Weisi and Weiliu Roads and Jingyi to Jingliu Roads; secondary roads including Jingsan and Wanyun Roads, 8 m) and the planned Xutao 330 kV substation. Page 4 land-use map (on an imagery basemap with a 1,000 m scale bar) shows the parcel bounded by Jingsan Road, Wanyun Road, the Sandang Highway corridor and Weiliu Road; it is registered to imagery in the geometry facts file.
sources.date_semantics: Plan published 20 August 2026 (PDF created the same day). Locator source only; not a status observation.
sources.coordinate_crs: No coordinates or datum printed. The page-4 map raster is registered to Esri World Imagery (EPSG:4326) by patch correlation; see the geometry facts file.

sources.title: Plan board: state-owned construction land parcel 卫地(G)[2026]-29 project planning and design scheme, pre-approval publicity (Volcano Engine)
sources.summary: Scheme board published with Zhongwei NRB pre-approval notice index 640501011/2026-00588 (publicity 24 August to 1 September 2026; designer China Electronics Engineering Design Institute). Parcel 卫地(G)[2026]-29 at Xuanhe Town, east Sandang Highway, south and west open land, north planned Weisi Road; 4.2587 ha (63.88 mu), industrial land for cloud computing and big-data centre use. Buildings: operations building, technology R&D laboratory, two super-core buildings, super-core diesel platform, auxiliary building, fire-water pool, oil tanks; GFA 38,217.15 m2. Renderings carry VOLCANO ENGINE signage. The 总平面图 shows the land line along 纬四路 and facing 三党公路 with a tilted north arrow; no coordinates are printed (labels are spot heights about 1366-1372 m).
